passed_cases.I08: P3 real local PostgREST preserved 11/31-minute-old and unknown fetchedAt without changing source data; SQL claim did not reject an old timestamp; production handler passed 11-minute-old fetchedAt to the mock provider and completed generation.
passed_cases.I07: P3 isolated PostgreSQL claim rejected a historical race; production Edge handler mock rejected malformed date before RPC and missing, invalid, or past close time before claim/provider.
passed_cases.G09: P3 real local PostgREST/production handler repeated the same selector, source facts and config; returned the same saved prediction ID and issued no additional provider request.

passed_cases.G11: P2 configuration hash tests changed model, style/version/text, thinking, output schema, adapter and prompt version. P3 same-input DB integration changed only model and produced a new job/bundle/provider call rather than reusing old output.
passed_cases.I09: P3 real local PostgREST: 120 concurrent RPC reads while day_heads switched 120 times between two ready synthetic batches; all returned internally consistent batchId/program/preview/component IDs. Fixture cleanup completed; residual race/batch/component/day_head count was 0.
passed_cases.D04: P3 production handler + real local PostgREST: 20 concurrent START requests held behind one mock provider response all returned the same job ID; exactly one worker/owner and one provider request completed the shared job.
passed_cases.D13: P3 local Supabase role test confirmed anon/authenticated cannot execute any AI RPC or read private job/bundle tables; service_role retains access. Local Edge HTTP smoke rejected public-key/selector/job-ID invalid cases. Production-handler responses omitted owner token, raw race facts, API key, input/config snapshots, hashes and request payload.
passed_cases.D08: P3 production handler + real local PostgREST/mock provider: an in-flight job was expired; GET returned terminal failure without another provider call or worker; later START replaced it with a new job and completed.
passed_cases.D09: P3 same delayed-worker scenario as D08: after replacement job became current, delayed old worker returned; stale owner saved no bundle while replacement job saved exactly one.
passed_cases.D01: P3 real local PostgREST/production handler/mock provider: success response was persisted and read; DB join confirmed one succeeded job, current/completed reuse key, succeeded winning attempt, and same bundle/reuse key.
passed_cases.D06: P3 real local PostgREST/production handler/mock provider: while first job request was held, source subtitle changed and a second START created a different job; persisted input bundles retained before/after values independently and both completed once.
passed_cases.D03: P3 production handler + real local PostgREST/mock provider: finish RPC committed the success bundle, then its HTTP response was dropped as 502; worker did not repeat the provider request, and job GET recovered one successful bundle/attempt.
passed_cases.T08: P2 mock client: Date.now jumped +24h then -24h during the request while the monotonic clock stayed within the shared deadline; combined with existing tests for ignored remainingMs extensions, transient GET recovery without another POST, and cancellation.
passed_cases.D11: P3 production handler + real local PostgREST: after close time elapsed, a new START returned closed without using cached success/provider; GET for the already completed job still returned the same saved bundle.
passed_cases.D14: P3 production handler + real local PostgREST: fetchedAt/last_success_at alone were refreshed after generation; next START reused the same snapshot without provider call, and saved inputBundle provenance retained the original fetchedAt.
passed_cases.D05: P3 real elapsed time + production handler/local PostgREST/mock provider: first START at +0s; second at +30s joined same job with no new worker/provider request; one result saved/read at +60s within the shared 90s lease.
passed_cases.D10: P3 real local PostgREST/production handler/mock provider: job was admitted with a future closeAt, first duplicate ticket answer arrived 3.5 seconds later after close, one repair succeeded, and one bundle saved after closed_at_at_admission while preserving the admitted input.
passed_cases.T11: P3 real local DB row-lock injection caused production-handler claim to stop in 2005ms under a 2s budget, generic retryable response, and zero provider requests. P2 client test performed one final job GET with 2s server time remaining and respected retryable=false without a second POST.
